about: Regular tasks of the google-ads and facebook-ads agents. ads_ops.py due lists what is overdue; ads_ops.py done <id> marks a run. Live account work always needs the owner logged in and their explicit yes; scheduled/cloud routines are read-only.

tasks.what: Read-only: delivery on all 3 levels, rejected/error ads, Account Quality, Event Match Quality, pacing vs the monthly ceiling in goals.md, creative fatigue checked against the attribution tool's value event, open ledger rows evaluated (keep or roll back).
Read-only: search terms (CSV export), pacing vs the ceiling in goals.md, disapprovals + Policy Manager, change history filtered on auto-applied, zero-impression stalls, open ledger rows evaluated.

Attribution tool: data sharing still active for Meta + Google, the value-event report still populated, spend in the attribution tool vs each Ads UI (cost import), 48 h without data = outage, SKAN conversion values.
Meta Ad Library + Google Ads Transparency Center for the competitor list in watchlist.md; new concepts/offers into ads-ops/learnings.md. Never target or name competitors.
Take the weekly read-only radar digest (scheduled routine), verify each item at the source, write the useful ones into ads-ops/learnings.md as hypotheses (new/check/decide).

Google asset report (Low rating after 14 days), Meta concept fatigue vs the value event; if a refresh is needed: brief 1-3 new concepts built on the current winner, language check, created PAUSED, shown to the owner.
Ask the owner the questions in ads-ops/goals.md in ONE message (goals, budgets, optimisation target, priorities, freeze windows, missing inputs); update goals.md with the answers and the date.
Phase 0 audit of every Business Portfolio / ad account; findings FAIL/pass/blocked + confidence; export snapshot to ads-ops/snapshots/.
Phase 0 audit of the MCC + all sub-accounts: auto-apply off (from the MCC), conversion actions primary/secondary, PMax vs Search cannibalisation; CSV export snapshot to ads-ops/snapshots/.
Full attribution tool + Events Manager + Google conversion audit against the measurement section of the starter pack; requests for whoever owns tracking written as tickets.
Meta vs Google cost per value event per market x OS from the attribution tool (30 days, actual spend incl. paused campaigns); proposal for the budget split, never executed without the owner.
Deep scan per skill ads-research-scan: Reddit via a real browser, changelogs, GitHub (MCP, optimisation and language repos), industry reports, trends; rows into ads-ops/learnings.md.
Fold adopted learnings into the agent files, remove stale snapshot numbers (point to status files instead), check shared copies for drift. Versions are kept automatically in .versions/.
Admins (2+ per portfolio/MCC, no former agencies), 2FA, partner access scope, payment method per legal entity, advertiser + any vertical-specific verification per country.
